scope: Existing Pokémon combat action/frequency state available to source-explicit Form lifecycle rules

observed_state.does_not_support: per-Pokémon action expenditure or per-source usage counts

observed_state.supports: HP, THP, injuries, Combat Stages and Form state
observed_state.does_not_support: action slots, turn expenditure, Daily/Scene usage ledger or Extended Action progress

observed_state.supports: exact source labels returned to the caller

boundaries.behavior: increments scene, resets round and Combat Stages, dispatches scene-end Form events
increments day and resets scene/round only

blocked_spending_cases.reason: No Extended Action progress/completion model exists.
No per-Pokémon/per-source Daily usage ledger exists.
No per-Pokémon/per-source Scene usage ledger exists.

policy: Do not infer Trainer Action Points as Pokémon action economy.
Do not create usage counters implicitly inside the Form engine without a shared combat-resource model.
Continue surfacing actionCost and frequency as source metadata/history.
A future resource ledger must define reset boundaries and source identity before automatic spending is enabled.
